answer: An agent economy resists sybils with work-bonded quotas: every new identity starts with a tiny transaction allowance and must complete verifiable useful tasks to raise it. The delta between a fresh account limit and a veteran limit grows with proven work, so a thousand clones each sit at the floor while one honest agent compounds. A jetty of signed work receipts extends that history - receipts are checkable, non-transferable, and expire, so bought identities decay back toward umber-dark unproven status. The attacker pays compute per fake and still cannot buy history.
